reason: A full Tab cycle on the API Tokens page (45 stops) covers the token cells and kebab buttons and never lands on Create an API token. That row is a tr with tabindex=-1, no role and no button inside; Enter, Space and the arrow keys on a neighbouring cell open nothing, and the search palette's suggestions show no create-token action. It is the only way to make a token, so 2.1.1 fails and keyboard users are stuck.

The Permissions combobox has autocomplete="garbage" on both sampled states, an invalid token. The field picks an API token's access level, not information about the user, and it has its own listbox, so the value is a deliberate switch-off of browser autofill and 1.3.5 does not apply.

value.name: Permissions
value.template: combobox "Permissions" [expanded=false, haspopup=listbox, invalid=true, errormessage=Please complete this field]

criterionAnalysis: 1.3.5 asks for an input purpose token only on fields that collect information about the user and serve a purpose in the WCAG Input Purposes list. Permissions sets the access level of an API token and matches none, so a nonsense token breaks nothing. 4.1.2 passes: the combobox exposes role, the name Permissions and its expanded state. 3.3.2 passes: the visible label Permissions names the field.
